summary: Preserved candidate PR 2463 and corrected its explicit-empty-model bypass by distinguishing only None from an empty string. CompletionRequest(model="", prompt="hello") now returns the OpenAI-compatible 404 model_not_found response before request conversion.

tests.what_was_measured: Against candidate df765c682bc88703e09f19714d75dfd4bbf42aa2 with only the new regression added, explicit model='' returned None from validate_served_model instead of a 404. See evidence/failing-before.log.
All five focused tests passed after the correction, including exact empty-model 404 payload and handle_request rejection before conversion. See evidence/passing-after.log.
Pytest collected and passed 5 tests and 2 subtests; warnings were deprecation/configuration warnings unrelated to the assertions.

gpu_execution.evidence: The defect is deterministic request validation before engine execution; no GPU or weights were used or required.

remaining_limitations: The prepared environment does not provide cargo or rustfmt, so the preserved Rust gateway tests were not compiled or executed in this correction run.
No full HTTP server was launched; the focused regression exercises the actual protocol model, shared validator, and handle_request pre-conversion gate.
